intro: At Northshire Vineyards, Defias brigands have seized the fields east of Northshire Abbey. The grapes once supplied wine to the clerics, but now the thieves plunder the harvest and threaten local farmers.

p: Northshire Vineyards lie east across the stream from Northshire Abbey, where workers such as Milly Osworth once tended the fields. Defias Brotherhood brigands now hold the acreage, led by Garrick Padfoot. The thieves plunder the harvest and strip local farmers of their livelihood. Their occupation gives new Brotherhood recruits a foothold close to the abbey.
